description: Close the Godot editor of the current project — only one this server opened with editor_launch (an editor the user opened is refused with EDITOR_NOT_LAUNCHED). Stops a running game, saves the open scenes unless save: false, quits, and waits for the process to end (stopped with SIGTERM after timeout_ms).

save.description: Save all open scenes first (default true).

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the editor to exit (default 20000).

name: editor_quit
title: Close the Godot editor
